notes.title: Upcoming Release & Season Exporting
notes.notes:
As release is coming up very soon, I figured this is a good time to do a quick community post. The first thing i would like to highlight is an improvement to season exporting.

[h2]Season Exporting[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40816505/dcbbe613c1ac0068a50b35ff5044f7ea10fe8b10.gif[/img]

By using the launch option [b]--JsonExporting[/b], all exported seasons will save as a Json file inside the game's directory, which will contain the majority of information in a season, including game, ladder and leaderboard data.

This is currently not in a fully finished state, as I plan to include more game data inside the json file (including stuff like error stats and more), however I feel that's it good to mention now in case someone wants to make a cool season viewer using this data (Like the one above, but like, much better)

[h2]1.0.0.0 Generation Calculations[/h2]

[list]
[*] Without middle names, there are a possibility of [b]194,481[/b] different player names that can be generated
[*] Including middle names, there are [b]5,639,949[/b] different player names that can be generated
[*] There are also [b]147,576[/b] different possibilities for the players look
[*] There are [b]61,500[/b] different team names that can be generated
[*] There are [b]273,000[/b] different jersey combinations
[*] The chance of getting a team (that isn't custom) with the exact same Name, Jersey & Logo (including colours) should be [b]1 in 906,633,000,000.[/b] That isn't even taking into account all the players, the players stats & their looks as well!
[/list]

[h2]Special Thanks To Beta Testers[/h2]

Lastly, I want to thank everyone who's spent even a second of their time playing this game during it's beta and getting back to me with as many bugs as they could find. There were some pretty big bugs found during this beta (including a lot of crashes, eek) that were able to be squashed due to some pretty intensive feedback.

Every bit of help that I got during this project has been greatly appreciated, and I hope that this game has truly been made better for it.

notes.title: SRL Simulator Release and Roadmap!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone, friendly SRL developer here. Now that the store page has been live for a couple of hours, I just wanted to share some plans for release and afterwards.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sqoXGqa.jpg[/img]

[u][b]1.0.0.0[/b][/u]

1.0.0.0 is currently scheduled to be released on the 31st July, however this is not a confirmed date and is subject to change. The features of the first release include everything that makes this game what it is, or simply put, the first release is a finished product.

By the way, did you know that the game and it's framework are all open-source? So if you don't want to wait for the steam release or you want to make modifications (or if you like pain, you can always try making a game from scratch in the framework), then you can just click the image below and you'll be sent to the github repo!

[url=https://github.com/Ritalin4Kidz/Custom-Console][img]https://i.imgur.com/eLXzUiF.png[/img][/url]

[u][b]1.1.0.0[/b][/u]

Future features have already been planned for this game, with the major one being the introduction of representative rounds. This feature was coined as the game went into beta for 1.0.0.0, which is why it won't be included in the main release.

There's no current time period for how long this update will take after 1.0.0.0 to release.

[u][b]1.2.0.0[/b][/u]

The release and features of 1.2.0.0 will depend heavily on the feedback from the prior two versions. This could be anything ranging from major changes to the calculations to simple quality of life improvements based off comments.


I plan to keep the announcements updated as much as I can before this game is officially released, including more in-depth explanations for how the game & simulations work. Until then though, enjoy this gif showcasing the Team In-Depth view

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9XDTSFw.gif[/img]

Kind Regards,
Callum <3
